[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Economy, Ships, and Combat[/color][/head]
Hullrot adds a frontier economy, purchasable ships, large-scale ship weapons, and long shifts built around player crews.
- Use [textlink="Banking and Credits" link="Bank"] to learn how personal ATMs and physical credits work. - Use [textlink="Buying and Selling Ships" link="Shipyard"] before purchasing or selling a vessel. - Use [textlink="Ship Combat" link="ShipCombat"] before operating turrets, fixed guns, hardpoints, or shields. - Use [textlink="Frontier Work and Cryosleep" link="UnionFrontier"] for a safe first approach to joining a crew and leaving a long round. - Use [textlink="Writing and Records" link="Writing"] for paper, stamps, and document formatting.
[color=#8fc98a]New players should join an established crew before buying a ship. A captain is responsible for the vessel, its passengers, and the consequences of its weapons.[/color]
